headline: Nothing alarming expected at Budapest.
one_line: The Danube at Budapest is expected to stay within its normal range this week and no significant rain is forecast over the next two days.
service: HungaroMet and the water directorate (OVF, vizugy.hu)
context: For context, from the past: Danube at Budapest, 21 September 2024: the river reached its highest level in around a decade, with water at the steps of the Parliament building. (history, from Wikipedia: 2024 Central European Floods, demo seed; not today's conditions)
